Have you seen the movie The Wolf of Wall Street? It's about a man who tricks people into buying junk stocks - expensively. He does it by making them believe he comes from a long-established and respected company on Wall Street. But it's all just a facade, the company "Stratton Oakmont" is a brand new company and has no history to speak of, they've just tried hard to make it seem like it is. To fool customers.

The pot or mug you can buy used on Tradera, stamped with the word Kockums, is made by a company that was founded by the Kockum family hundreds of years ago. Parts of that company were sold and the last remaining crumbs of the company were dissolved in 1991. The business no longer exists. The people, the machines and the expertise are long gone.

Similarity between Stratton Oakmont and today's Kockums Jernverk AB? The history you think there is - does not exist.

Kockums Jernverk AB is a completely new company (2017) and has no connection whatsoever to the old, venerable company that manufactured Kockums products. They are only trying to make you believe that you are buying an honest, traditional product, full of history. That they have almost managed to kick-start the Swedish factory again.

But that is not the case.. Kockums Jernverks AB disappeared in 1991. Then the trademark was protected for 10 years by the Swedish Patent and Registration Office. But the original company was dissolved and therefore did not claim the trademark. So after ten years the trademark became free for anyone to register. Which these gentlemen did in 2017.... Then they try their hardest to parasitize on the history and nostalgia surrounding the original, venerable company. But they really have no connection whatsoever to it. Zero connection.

Most of the products also have no Swedish connection whatsoever. They are manufactured in Serbia, Holland and Germany. Quite frankly, an enamel bowl from Rusta or Öob has more history than one from the current Kockums Jernverk AB. Both Rusta and ÖoB are older companies than Kockums Jernverk AB.

An insult and downright shameful.
